scope: Primary-source strategy references, not vehicle acceptance

sources.read_scope: Complete CAGEBOT TR single-shaft wired motor product page, including specification text
findings: Listed rated voltage DC4.5V, applicable voltage DC3V to6V, reduction1/55 and rotational speed130rpm plus/minus10 percent
sources.transfer_limit: The installed motor is not identified as this TR product. The page does not specify rotational-speed load conditions, step response, stopping time or torque curve. These values cannot replace vehicle measurements or set simulation acceleration/latency
sources.followup: Identify the installed motor and transmission, then measure wheel diameter, loaded wheel speed, reversal lag and battery voltage

sources.read_scope: Full usage.md via raw GitHub: calibration, line position and PD example
findings: Expose every sensor to both reflectance extremes
Use monotonic line position for feedback
Tune signs and gains at low speed before increasing motor commands
sources.transfer_limit: QTR API and numerical gains are not calibrated for this vehicle; this controller uses different derivative scaling

findings: Bound wheel commands after PD mixing
Example explicitly limits its tested course and motor conditions
sources.transfer_limit: Different motors, sensor array and PWM scale; do not adopt its powered calibration in stationary capture mode

sources.read_scope: Ben replies on gain tuning, monotonic position, lost-line direction, calibration height and logging
findings: Keep last seen direction when detecting loss
Avoid lifting the robot during calibration
sources.transfer_limit: 2011 discussion on another robot; no present-vehicle performance guarantee

sources.read_scope: Full arXiv v1 HTML, especially sections IV-C through IV-F and VII; figures and source code not reproduced
findings: Authors use a finite recent-error window for integral action
A sharp turn can make the most recent positional error point opposite the intended exit
Authors distinguish short loss from persistent loss and use outer-sensor history for recovery
Authors report traction and sensor spacing as practical limits
sources.transfer_limit: The paper concerns another platform and course. Its reading-count thresholds, PWM fractions, voltage choices and gains are not this vehicle's settings. No experiment reproduced; HTML equations require checking against PDF before reuse
sources.followup: Compare recovery direction history against actual sensor-order evidence; inspect source sample-time units before any port

sources.read_scope: Repository landing page and platform description only
findings: Companion implementation targets STM32F103C8 and QTR-8RC
sources.transfer_limit: Code not audited, compiled or ported; library, platform and license must be checked before reuse
sources.followup: Inspect control source and sample-time units before considering implementation reuse
